title: Measured force-decline datasets not used to fit Frey Law, Looft and Heitsman 2012
source: Vernillo G et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2018;50:334-343 (published after the 2012 model, so cannot have been in its fit) and Allman BL and Rice CL, Med Sci Sports Exerc 2000;32(5) Suppl abstract 829 (a conference abstract; the 2012 fit set was not re-read in this unit, so independence of this one is unconfirmed).
rows: Elbow flexor MVC force at the end of a 2 min sustained maximal contraction, as % of the pre value
12 healthy young men; 2 min sustained isometric maximal voluntary contraction (duty cycle 100%); +/- 8 (Low and High are mean -/+ that)
Force fell with the knee extensors until 35 s; at 95 s the elbow flexors were at 35% of baseline.
Knee extensor MVC force at the end of the same 2 min contraction
At 95 s the knee extensors were at 26% of baseline.
Elbow flexor MVC force after 50 contractions of an intermittent task
6 men; isometric contractions 3 s on, 2 s off (duty 3/5 = 60%, computed from the stated times) at 60% MVC, continued until force fell below 60% MVC
The abstract says MVC 'declined linearly to approximately 56% within 50 contractions' (about 250 s); recovered to about 82% in 3 min and not fully within an hour.
